events.title: 퀸스 파크 레인저스 easily make it through to the second round of the UEFA Cup with a 4–0 win over KR Reykjavik, 7–0 on aggregate. The match is played at Highbury as UEFA will not allow 레인저스 to use their artificial pitch at Loftus Road. 에버턴 beat University College Dublin in the Cup Winners' Cup but only thanks to a single 그레엄 샤프 goal at Goodison Park . Fourth Division leaders 헤리퍼드 유나이티드 concede their first league goals of the season in their eighth match, a 3–1 defeat at 체스터필드.

노팅엄 포리스트 and 사우샘프턴 are knocked out of Europe but 리버풀, 맨체스터 유나이티드, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 렉섬 all progress. John Wark scores a hat-trick in 리버풀's 4–0 win over Lech Poznań and Garth Crooks bags three for the second time in eight days as Spurs beat 브라가 6–0.

아스널 are back on top of the table – a Charlie Nicholas penalty gives them victory over 에버턴 while 토트넘 홋스퍼 lose 1–0 at 사우샘프턴. 리버풀's woes continue as 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 hold them to a goalless draw at Anfield. The last unbeaten record in the First Division goes as 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 3–0 at 애스턴 빌라. On-loan French winger Didier Six stars on his Villa debut. With 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 losing 1–0 at 맨체스터 시티 – their first defeat away from home since February – 포츠머스 are now the only side yet to be beaten in the league this season.
코번트리 시티 crash out of the Milk Cup, beaten 3–0 at home by last season's semi-finalists 월솔 , 4–2 on aggregate. 리버풀 need extra time to get past 스톡포트 카운티.
토트넘 홋스퍼 move ahead of 아스널 on goal difference at the top of the table with a 1–0 win over 리버풀.

아스널 return to the summit with a 4–1 win at 레스터 시티. 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain in touch with a 5–1 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 왓퍼드, the only side without a league win this season, break their duck by beating 첼시 3–2 at Stamford Bridge.
카디프 시티 move off the bottom of the Second Division at the expense of 노츠 카운티 with a 2–0 win at Meadow Lane .

A watershed moment in the season as 에버턴 win at Anfield for the first time in 14 years. 그레엄 샤프 scores the only goal with a brilliant volley. 아스널 unveil their new 18ft x 14ft video screen for extra match day entertainment, the first of its kind in English football. On the pitch, the Gunners beat 선덜랜드 3–2 to retain top spot. 토트넘 홋스퍼 slip to fifth after a 1–0 defeat at 맨체스터 유나이티드 while 셰필드 웬즈데이 move up to second with a 5–0 win over 레스터 시티. 포츠머스 suffer their first league defeat, losing 3–2 at 윔블던.

In only his second match back following a knee operation, 이언 러시 scores a hat-trick in 리버풀's 3–1 European Cup win over 벤피카 . 에버턴 win at 포르튀나 시타르트 in the Cup Winners' Cup through an early goal by Paul Bracewell . In the UEFA Cup, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 beat Partizan Belgrade 6–2 at Highbury but 토트넘 홋스퍼 lose to Bruges with 글렌 호들 sent off and 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw with PSV 에인트호번 .

In-form 에버턴 thrash 맨체스터 유나이티드 5–0, United's biggest margin of defeat since losing 6–0 at 입스위치 타운 in March 1980. Leaders 아스널 are beaten 3–1 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 토트넘 홋스퍼 heap more misery on bottom club 스토크 시티 with a 4–0 win at White Hart Lane . 레스터 시티 striker 게리 리네커 scores a hat-trick in his side's 5–0 win over 애스턴 빌라.
Having slipped into the bottom three, 리버풀 begin the climb to safety with a 2–0 win at 노팅엄 포리스트.

첼시 need a late Colin Lee equaliser to rescue a 2–2 draw at 월솔 in the Milk Cup third round. 에버턴 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 for the second time in four days, 2–1 at Old Trafford . Ex-Evertonian John Gidman heads the winner into his own goal.

아스널 are knocked out of the Milk Cup, beaten 3–2 at Second Division leaders 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. David Langan scores the winner thanks to a mistake by 팻 제닝스. 리버풀's 1–0 defeat at 토트넘 홋스퍼 is the first tie the holders have lost in the competition since the 1979–80 season. Improving 왓퍼드 enjoy a comprehensive 4–0 win at 리즈 유나이티드.
